page.overview:
What is 72 Seasons?

72 Seasons is the eleventh studio album by American heavy metal band Metallica. It was released on April 14, 2023.

On November 28, 2022, Metallica would drop the music video for their lead single Lux Æterna introducing the new album to the world. They would also announce the subsequent M72 World Tour that would follow post release. On January 19, 2023, they would release the music video for the album's second single Screaming Suicide. On February 25-28, 2023, the band would tease an upcoming song on TikTok with each band member making a duet to the song each day, the final duet announced the release date of the music video for the album's third single If Darkness Had a Son. On March 27, 2023, the band teased on all of their social media platforms, with a short video with the upcoming song's music video release date for the album's fourth single 72 Seasons. On September 15, 2023, the band released a live rendition of the song Too Far Gone? as the fifth single of the album.
